about.title: About TaskFlow
about.missionDescription: TaskFlow exists to help people organize their lives beautifully and privately. We believe productivity tools should respect your privacy, work offline, and never lock your data behind paywalls. Our mission is to provide a free, powerful, and privacy-first task management experience for everyone.
about.developerDescription: TaskFlow is developed by an independent developer passionate about privacy-focused productivity tools. The app is built with modern web technologies and is available on Android through the Google Play Store.
about.privacyDescription: All your data stays on your device. We don't collect analytics, don't track you, and don't require accounts. TaskFlow is free and will always provide a generous free experience.

support.freeExperience: TaskFlow is free and will always provide a generous free experience.
support.donationDescription: If TaskFlow has helped you stay productive, you can support its continued development with a completely optional donation.
support.contributionDescription: Every contribution helps fund new features, bug fixes, performance improvements and future updates.
support.thankYou: Thank you for helping TaskFlow grow.
support.comingSoon: Support options will become available after the Play Store release.
support.noPaymentInfo: No payment information is collected by TaskFlow. All donations are processed securely through Google Play Billing.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.introduction: This Privacy Policy describes how TaskFlow ("we", "our", "us") handles your information when you use our mobile application. We built TaskFlow with privacy as a core principle, and this policy explains what data stays on your device, what data never leaves your device, and your rights as a user.
privacy.dataStored: Your tasks, notes, and task-related data
privacy.appPreferences: App usage preferences (theme, sort order, etc.)
privacy.supporterStatus: Supporter status (if you make a donation)
privacy.whatNeverLeaves: What Data Never Leaves Your Device
privacy.localStorage: All your task data is stored locally on your device
privacy.noSync: Your data is not synced to any server or cloud service
privacy.noPersonalInfo: No personal information is collected or stored
privacy.noAnalytics: No analytics or tracking is performed
privacy.noAuthRequired: TaskFlow does not require an account or authentication. All data is stored locally on your device.
privacy.noAnalyticsDescription: TaskFlow does not collect any analytics or usage data. We respect your privacy and do not track your activity.
privacy.noCrashReporting: TaskFlow does not include crash reporting or error logging. Any errors are handled locally without sending data anywhere.
privacy.donationsBilling: Donations are processed through Google Play Billing only
privacy.noPaymentStorage: No payment information is stored by TaskFlow
privacy.supporterFlag: Only a boolean flag (is_supporter = true) is stored locally after a successful donation
privacy.noFinancialInfo: No personal financial information is collected or transmitted
privacy.noPushNotifications: TaskFlow does not use push notifications or any notification system that requires device permissions or data transmission.
privacy.deleteData: You can delete all your data at any time through Settings → Data & Privacy → Reset All Data
privacy.deviceOnly: Your data remains on your device only
privacy.uninstallRemove: You can uninstall the app to remove all data
privacy.dataSecurityDescription: All data is stored on your device using the platform's standard secure storage. TaskFlow does not transmit your personal data to any external server. We recommend keeping your device operating system up to date and using device-level security features such as a screen lock.
privacy.childrenPrivacyDescription: TaskFlow does not knowingly collect any personal information from children under 13 (or the applicable age in your jurisdiction). The app does not require account creation and stores no data off-device.
privacy.changesDescription: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. When we do, we will revise the "Last updated" date at the top of this policy. Continued use of TaskFlow after a change indicates that you agree to the updated policy.
privacy.contactText: For privacy questions or concerns, please contact:
